title: What Chasing God Instead of a Wife Actually Looks Like
caption:
What chasing God instead of a wife actually looks like.

It's not waiting around and hoping she notices.

Seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well (Matthew 6:33). Singleness isn't a waiting room. It's where He's building something in you that has nothing to do with her yet.

Let your prayer life outgrow your dating life. Get built before you go looking. The guy chasing a wife reeks of it. The guy chasing God becomes the guy worth marrying.

theme: He chases God, not a wife.
